reason: Harness 0.x: `ExaSearch`'s `num_results` is renamed to `max_results` and kept as a deprecated alias. The alias is keyword-only; `max_results` takes its first positional slot, so `ExaSearch(3)` behaves as before. `ExaSearch(num_results=...)` still works and warns; read `max_results` instead of `num_results`.
